title: Pairing is linear in the matrix
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $A,B$ be $n\times n$ matrices over $\mathbb{F}_2$, and let $x,y\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$. The pairing of $A-B$ against $x$ and $y$ equals the pairing of $A$ against $x,y$ minus the pairing of $B$ against $x,y$.
